title: Durgeswar Sarma Rachanavali: Collected Historical Dramas, Poetry and Critical Essays
author: Dr. Mohendra Bora (Editor)
genre: Historical Dramas, Patriotic Poetry & Medieval Assam Chronicles
description: Comprehensive collected works of pioneering litterateur Durgeswar Sarma, edited by eminent scholar Dr. Mohendra Bora, Lakshminath Bezbaroa Professor of Assamese, Dibrugarh University. The collection contains celebrated historical dramas ('Partha Parajaya', 'Bali Badh', 'Padmini'), patriotic songs, and essays chronicling Ahom kingship, Patkai crossings, and Tai cultural legacy.
